# Edge inference for mental health screening on low-cost devices

- Autores: Jorge Díaz, Elena Mora
- Año: 2025
- Venue: Computers in Biology and Medicine
- Cuartil: Q1
- DOI/URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00003

## Abstract

Rural clinics lack the hardware to run large screening models.
We compress a multimodal depression classifier with quantization and distillation.
The compressed model runs on a single-board computer in under one second.
Accuracy drops by less than two points. Edge deployment makes screening feasible offline.
